asset.name: ModelPicker
asset.description: The model selector presenting capability, cost, speed, availability, and context limits in role-oriented terms rather than exposing raw identifiers and parameter counts.

requires.reason: Selection, keyboard model, and responsive presentation are shared.
Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.

rationale: The design failure to avoid is a dropdown of opaque model names. The choice a user is actually making is between speed, cost, and capability, and the component should present that.
